search.browserOnly: Open the Clip Harbour desktop window (npm run tauri -- dev). The browser cannot search.
search.noResultsYet: No results yet. Search a term or paste a YouTube URL.
search.noVideos: No videos found. Try another search.
search.browserHintTitle: You are in the browser (Vite), not the desktop app.
search.browserHintBody: Search and downloads only work in the native Clip Harbour window. Start with npm run tauri -- dev and use that window (not just localhost:1420).
search.previewNotFileMeta: Not file tags. Those are chosen at download (“Embed metadata”).

download.fetchHint: If this never finishes, run the app with Tauri (not the browser) and check that yt-dlp sidecar is available.
download.noFormats: No formats available for this video.
download.needFolder: Choose a download folder before starting.
download.cookiesHint403: 403: check YouTube cookies in the sidebar.
download.modeStandardHint: Best audio by default; one download of the selected format.
download.modeUsbHint: Best audio → M4A (BMW USB). You can switch to MP3.
download.modePcHint: Best quality without conversion (Opus/WebM). Not suitable for car USB.
download.modeUsbFallback: Manual output differs from the recommended M4A for USB.

cookies.title: YouTube cookies
cookies.hint: Use a YouTube cookies.txt to avoid the anti-bot block.
cookies.refreshFailed: Could not extract cookies from the browser. Close Firefox/Chrome/Edge and use Refresh cookies or Choose cookies.txt.
cookies.refreshFailedHint: Could not extract cookies: close the browsers (Firefox/Chrome/Edge) and try again, or pick a cookies.txt manually.

errors.COOKIES_INVALID: The cookies file is invalid. Export real cookies (Netscape) with an extension after signing in to YouTube and pick it in the sidebar.
errors.COOKIES_NO_SESSION: The cookies have no YouTube session (SID/HSID missing). Sign in in your browser and try again.
errors.COOKIES_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The cookies file does not exist. Check the path in the sidebar.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: YouTube has rate-limited this session (up to ~1 hour). Wait a while and avoid launching several videos in a row.
errors.AUTH_BLOCK: YouTube asks you to confirm you're not a bot. Set up a cookies.txt in the sidebar or wait a few minutes.
errors.DIR_ACCESS: Could not create the download folder (permission denied). Choose another folder or check that the path exists.
errors.NO_RESULTS: No results found for that search. Try another query or set up YouTube cookies.
errors.YTDLP_SPAWN: Could not launch yt-dlp. Make sure it is installed as a sidecar.
errors.YTDLP_FAILED: yt-dlp could not complete the operation.
errors.NO_DATA: yt-dlp returned no data. Try again.
errors.PARSE_JSON: Could not parse YouTube's response. Try again.
errors.INTERNAL: An unexpected error occurred. Check the console or try again.
